summary:
P1 is CONFIRMED and fixed. The Cloudflare line in privacy section 5 is now plain text in every case. The fork `cloudflare_clause` is removed from scripts/legal_variants_u8.json. The markdown already carried the line inline in EN and AR, so no document, page or Arabic text changed and nothing was re-rendered.

How P1 was confirmed: probe_p1.py ran on scratch copies and left the worktree untouched. Four address pairs filled with rc 0 and dropped the line from the EN and AR markdown and from both privacy pages: privacy@qaren.app + help@gmail.com, privacy@gmail.com + support@qaren.app, privacy@mail.qaren.app + support@qaren.app, and both addresses off qaren.app. In each of those cases the filled policy no longer names Cloudflare, so T7a would turn red at the fill-in. Outside the legal regions the landing pages hard-code support@qaren.app on all six legal pages: privacy.html:326, terms.html:264, support.html:7,9,199,204,207, ar/privacy.html:320, ar/terms.html:255, ar/support.html:7,9,198,203,206.

Order of work: two nodes were appended and run red first: a static node plus a fill-in node over five address pairs. Rewriting test_polish_a12b was unavoidable: it pinned the both-addresses rule, so every truthful fix turns it red (see Q1). The fix followed. Four byte-copy mutants were all killed, and every restore was sha-verified.

Gates: the backend files have T2 as the only red ([pyt] fix2-backend5: 1 failed, 153 passed). The renderer --check passed, the jest subset is green and tsc is clean. Three files changed. This settles the polish report's Q3: T7a no longer turns red at the fill-in.

questions_for_orchestrator: Q1 (ruling amendment needed): Fix P1 replaces UP4 A12(b). The Cloudflare line of s5 is now unconditional plain text, so the derived-clause rule ('empty unless both e-mail placeholders end in @qaren.app') is gone. This is consistent with UG7, because T7a names Cloudflare unconditionally. Please record it as a dated amendment (UP10) and accept one exception to binding rule 3. test_polish_a12b had to change, because it pinned the both-addresses rule and every truthful fix reddens it. Old node id: test_polish_a12b_cloudflare_line_only_for_qaren_app_mailboxes. New node id: test_polish_a12b_cloudflare_line_kept_whatever_the_mailboxes. Its mixed case is inverted, and its post-fill refusal now asserts SUPPORT_EMAIL. The finding's own fix text named this node as changeable. The alternative was a second red next to T2, which would break binding rule 1.

Q2 (PR body): line 19 of u8/PR_NOTES_POLISH.md is stale. I did not edit it because the file belongs to another agent. Replacement line: '- The Cloudflare line of privacy section 5 is unconditional (fix P1 amends UP4 A12b): the landing pages publish support@qaren.app outside the legal regions, so email to a qaren.app address passes through Cloudflare whatever PRIVACY_EMAIL and SUPPORT_EMAIL are. T7a stays green at the fill-in. If the owner later moves every address AND the landing chrome off qaren.app, revisit the line, the Cloudflare manifest row and T7a together.' This also settles the polish report's Q3.

Q3 (unused code): fill_in_legal.py keeps two generic mechanisms that no fork now uses and no node exercises: the {'all_end_with': [...], 'suffix': s} answer form in _Filler._answer and the one-empty-variant rule in _Filler._apply_fork. The polish round's mutants F13, F14, F15 and V5 on them would now survive. Keep them? The variants _comment documents them as unused. Or remove them in a cleanup unit with a refusal pin? I left the script untouched to keep this round to the finding.

Q4 (seen in adv-polish/notes.md, not in my finding list, not touched): (a) d3=B with openai_store_pinned false publishes 'rather than the 30-day limit below', but in that variant no 30-day sentence follows. (b) A TRANSFER_BASIS_COUNSEL value written as a '- ' list renders inline after 'Germany (Sentry).' (rc 0). (c) A DPO value given in EN only or AR only is accepted, so EN and AR can diverge. Schedule them, or accept them as stated limits?
stated_limits: 1 (kept) The renderer is strict: render_regions raises when any of the six sources is missing. The AR pages have no EN fallback.

2 (kept) The fill-in can re-select a FORK after a fill-in, because it recognises both the raw and the filled variant. A derived clause (DELETION_SECTION, MINORS_CLAUSE, YOUTUBE_CLAUSE, INAPP_NOTIF_CLAUSE, TRANSFER_BASIS, DPO_CONTACT) cannot be re-selected once its token is replaced. A changed answer is refused instead (exit 3 with the 'restore the pre-fill markdown from git' hint).

3 (amended by UP8 F1) The post-fill checks are substring tests. A changed value that also occurs elsewhere in its language's documents passes. A {value} clause changed to '' is caught only through the absence of its non-empty literal tail. An empty variant cannot be checked for presence.

4 (kept) Placeholder keys without _AR are checked against the English documents only, and _AR keys against the Arabic ones. A shared key (CONTROLLER_NAME, POSTAL_ADDRESS, PRIVACY_EMAIL, SUPPORT_EMAIL, CR_NUMBER) is caught through its EN occurrence or the d5 fork.

5 (amended by UP3, UP4 A10/B5 and UP8 F1) A non-empty placeholder value that no selected variant uses is refused (exit 3, 'set it null'). An empty string is accepted only for HOSTING_REGIONS and HOSTING_REGIONS_AR. An empty value for a token that only an UNSELECTED variant uses does not block that variant's recognition.
6 (kept) D-NEW uses the PR #290 paragraph with the spec's deletion path. The branch-A clause is dropped (UP5), so in branch A the text over-discloses a de-identified stub that is in fact removed.
7 (amended by A8) D-OLD is truthful to migration 025 but reads badly, by design. s3.4 now lists notification records, which closes F-REENG.

8 (amended by A15) The policy assumes U3c (or its fold into U3b) and store=False at publication. The referral sentence is a fork on REFERRAL_PUSH_DISPLAY_NAME_ONLY: null or 'false' publishes the email-prefix wording, and the merge gate requires 'true'. 'We have not opted in' (D3 = A) is true only once the owner turns OpenAI organisation data sharing off.

9 (amended by F3) UF7's sentence covers our servers. The App's reports are disclosed separately, including 'Performance traces from the App record the same request addresses.' UF7's two remaining limits are not stated in the policy: the redis:// fallback puts cache keys into breadcrumbs, and the paths of unmatched routes are kept verbatim.

10 (kept, UP1) The App sentence keeps 'which for a comparison can include the product names' until sentry.ts's query rung covers product_a, product_b and url (unit CLIENT-TRUTH). App exception values are sent raw apart from token shapes. Device and OS fields come from SDK defaults and were not measured on a device.

11 (amended by F5) The picture sentence covers ProductImage.tsx: pictures load from the 'retailer, image or search-engine website' that published them. The retailer manifest row lists no hosts (one class).
12 (kept) Linked security rows are kept 'as long as your account exists' because no job expires them. SECURITY_LOG_RETENTION applies only to the unlinked failed-sign-in and lockout rows.
13 (kept) Railway logs 'can record' the requester's IP and the requested address. Railway retention, and whether it records client IPs, are NOT VERIFIED.
14 (kept) 'Expire within 6 hours' for short-lived security checks and cache copies is derived from the T28/T29 TTLs.

15 (kept; now also the basis of fix P1) The landing chrome outside the legal regions hard-codes support@qaren.app on all six legal pages and both index pages: meta refresh, CTA, note, footer. SUPPORT_EMAIL appears only inside the regions.
16 (kept) ?lang=ar with a missing AR file returns the route's existing 'Content not available.' body. There is no EN fallback.

17 (amended by B6) The renderer refuses markdown outside the subset with LegalRenderError (rc 2 for --check, rc 3 for the fill-in). Sources are read as utf-8-sig. A TRANSFER_BASIS_COUNSEL value written as a list still renders glued into its paragraph (adv-polish note, accepted rc 0, not fixed).
18 (amended by A10) Placeholder values may not contain < > [ ] backtick, * or line breaks. Keys ending in _COUNSEL or _COUNSEL_AR may span lines and use *, within the renderer's subset.

19 (B2, FIXED in polish) Every page's marker pair and every filled source is checked through the renderer BEFORE the first write, and main() catches the render error. A renderer failure after the markdown writes is reported as RenderAfterWriteError (rc 3).

20 (kept, widened) The fix and polish nodes are coupled to code: A1 parses sentry.ts's query rung, A2 asserts ProductImage.tsx's remote Image source, A4 reads migrations/025, and the polish and fix2 nodes run the real fill_in_legal.py and legal_variants_u8.json on temp copies.
21 (UP4 A12a) CONTROLLER_COUNTRY must be null or 'Bahrain'. s7 and s10 hard-code Bahrain, so any other country is refused until they are re-drafted.

22 (UP4 A11) A fixed retention period (a digit or a duration word in EN or AR) is refused unless RETENTION_CLEANUP_LIVE is 'true'. The heuristic is word-based: 'a decade' and 'a fortnight' pass (adv-polish note).
23 (UP4 A12c) DPO_CONTACT_DETAILS and _AR are independent. One without the other is accepted, so the EN and AR documents can diverge.

24 (fix P1, new) The Cloudflare line of privacy s5 is unconditional. If the owner records off-qaren addresses AND the landing chrome is later moved off qaren.app, the line over-discloses a recipient. Cloudflare Email Routing delivery for qaren.app is itself NOT VERIFIED (spec P16, form item 5).
25 (fix P1, new) fill_in_legal.py keeps the all_end_with answer form and the one-empty-variant fork rule as generic machinery that no fork uses. No node exercises them after this round (Q3).
26 (fix P1, new) test_polish_a12b was renamed and rewritten, an exception to binding rule 3 (Q1). tests/test_legal_docs_u8_polish.py now holds 68 nodes (was 62).
